description: A '- ' line that isn't '- YYYY-MM-DD (<run>): <fact>' (an impossible date, no run, a run with a space, no date, an empty fact, a fact that starts with a space, plain text, year 0000, an invisible character such as a tag, bidi override or zero-width space) is skipped with one bad-note warning each. Lines that don't start with '- ' are ignored silently.
